standards.title: Centrifugal Pumps — Specification
standards.scope: This standard specifies requirements for centrifugal pumps used for clear, cold water for agricultural, industrial and domestic supply purposes. Covers single-stage and multi-stage horizontal and vertical centrifugal pumps.
standards.certification_details: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) applicable under CRS

standards.title: Horizontal Centrifugal Pumps for Clear, Cold Water — Testing — Part 1: Methods of Test
standards.scope: Methods of testing horizontal centrifugal pumps for clear, cold water. Covers performance tests, NPSH tests, and mechanical run tests.

standards.title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
standards.scope: Specifies safety requirements for information technology equipment including computers, printers, scanners, and peripherals. Covers electrical safety, mechanical safety, temperature requirements, and fire resistance.
standards.certification_details: Compulsory BIS Registration under CRS Order for IT equipment

standards.title: Room Air Conditioners — Specification — Part 1: Unitary Air Conditioners
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for factory-made unitary room air conditioners. Covers cooling capacity, energy efficiency ratio, noise levels, electrical safety, and refrigerant requirements.
standards.certification_details: BIS Registration mandatory under CRS Order

standards.title: Solar Flat Plate Collector — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for solar flat plate collectors used in domestic and industrial water heating applications. Covers thermal performance, materials, pressure testing, and durability requirements.
standards.certification_details: BIS Product Certification for solar thermal equipment

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel for general structural purposes including bridges, buildings, and general engineering. Covers chemical composition, mechanical properties, and testing.
standards.certification_details: Compulsory BIS certification for structural steel

standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
standards.scope: Code of practice for general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete. Covers design, materials, durability, workmanship, mix design, and structural requirements for concrete construction.

standards.title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100V — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated cables and cords with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to 1100V. Covers conductor sizes, insulation thickness, voltage rating, and testing.
standards.certification_details: Compulsory BIS Registration under CRS for PVC cables

standards.title: Safety of Machinery — General Principles for Design
standards.scope: Specifies basic terminology, methodology, and general principles for design to achieve safety of machinery. Covers risk assessment, risk reduction, protective measures, and safe design principles.

standards.title: Three Phase Induction Motors — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for three phase cage induction motors rated up to and including 315 kW. Covers ratings, performance, testing, marking, and dimensions.
standards.certification_details: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) for electric motors

standards.title: End-Suction Centrifugal Pumps (Other than those for Agricultural Purposes) — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for end-suction centrifugal pumps used for general industrial and municipal water supply purposes. Covers hydraulic performance, dimensions, materials, testing, and marking.

standards.title: Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars, and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Specification — Part 1: Mild Steel Tubes
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for mild steel tubes for water, gas, sewage, and steam services. Covers dimensions, materials, testing, galvanizing, and threading.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater — Part 17: Non-Filterable Residue (Total Suspended Solids)
standards.scope: Prescribes methods for determination of total suspended solids in water and wastewater samples.

standards.title: Drinking Water — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for drinking water quality. Covers physical, chemical, bacteriological, and radiological requirements including permissible and desirable limits.

standards.title: Code of Basic Requirements for Water Supply, Drainage and Sanitation
standards.scope: Provides basic requirements for water supply, drainage, and sanitation installations in buildings. Covers water demand, plumbing fixtures, pipe sizing, drainage, and sanitary installations.

standards.title: Design Loads (Other than Earthquake) for Buildings and Structures — Code of Practice — Part 3: Wind Loads
standards.scope: Specifies wind loads and wind effects on buildings and structures. Covers basic wind speed, terrain categories, wind pressure coefficients, and dynamic wind effects.

standards.title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures — Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
standards.scope: Specifies criteria for earthquake resistant design of structures. Covers seismic zone map, response spectra, base shear, structural requirements, and ductile detailing provisions.

standards.title: Technical Requirements for Installation of Centrifugal Pumps
standards.scope: Specifies technical requirements for installation of centrifugal pumps including foundation, alignment, piping, suction conditions, and commissioning procedures.

standards.title: Energy Efficient Induction Motors — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for energy efficient three-phase cage induction motors. Covers IE2 and IE3 efficiency classes, performance, testing, and marking requirements.
standards.certification_details: BIS Certification for energy efficient motors

standards.title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Lines — Part 1: Aluminium Stranded Conductors
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for aluminium stranded conductors (AAC) for use in overhead power transmission and distribution lines.
